decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already records the Thursday-morning submission deadline and the consequence that late clips will not be posted that week; no further candidate-state change is required.
The source applies the existing client-approval-before-publication gate to the current batch but does not change its approval authority, eligibility rule, or rejected-clip handling.
The publication schedule and late-delivery policy do not alter the permitted or required content sources, whose same-message changes are already recorded.
The current batch publication schedule has no necessary effect on the future Lead Clipper pathway, compensation, training, or responsibilities.
A five-clip batch deadline and Friday publication schedule do not change the deferred monthly quota, its counting rule, or its daily cadence.
The source publication timing does not change the clean-editing rules; the source's direct editing-style scope application is already represented by a same-message Event.
The publication timing does not change caption color, font, or effects; the source's application of those standards to monthly production is already represented.
The source concerns the first production batch going live, not the already completed qualification process, so its deadline does not replace the qualification deadline or method.
The publication schedule does not change the complete-moment or audience-comprehension criteria; the source's direct content-standard update is already recorded.
The Thursday delivery and Friday publication conditions do not modify the standard for selecting strong source moments.
The source publication schedule does not alter the existing 45-to-60-second duration requirement.
